# Phone Number Vue (@erag/phone-number-vue)

> Headless Vue 3 composable (`usePhoneNumber`) for country-aware phone inputs. Handles country selection, digit normalization, calling codes, mask patterns, and validation with zero dependencies.

## Core Information
- **Package**: `@erag/phone-number-vue`
- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/phone-number-vue/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/phone-number-vue
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Peer Dependencies**: `vue` (^3.3.0)
- **Keywords**: vue, vue3, composition-api, composable, phone-input, phone-number, international-phone, headless, validation

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install @erag/phone-number-vue
# or
pnpm add @erag/phone-number-vue
# or
yarn add @erag/phone-number-vue
```

## Quick Start (usePhoneNumber Composable)
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { usePhoneNumber } from '@erag/phone-number-vue'

const {
  countries,
  selectedCountry,
  callingCode,
  phone,
  handleInput,
  isValid,
  maskPattern,
  formatExample
} = usePhoneNumber({ initialCountry: 'IN' })
</script>

<template>
  <div class="phone-input-group">
    <select v-model="selectedCountry">
      <option
        v-for="c in countries"
        :key="c.code"
        :value="c"
      >
        {{ c.name }} ({{ c.dial_code }})
      </option>
    </select>

    <span class="calling-code">{{ callingCode }}</span>

    <input
      type="tel"
      :value="phone"
      :placeholder="maskPattern || formatExample"
      @input="handleInput"
    />

    <span v-if="phone && !isValid" class="error">
      Please enter a valid phone number
    </span>
  </div>
</template>
```
